payload.author: coordinator
evidence: Pinned parse_string has five calls to628B30 and eight to memcpy645930. The baseline Release object has no findnum/memcpy call relocations in parse_string, but ten findnum_digits references corresponding to five inlined scans. A standalone findnum COMDAT exists, without a retained MAP placement. This is stronger evidence than spelling similarity, but does not establish original translation-unit boundaries.

findnum is used only by parse_string in current source. stoi instead serves Text decimal conversion and has two associated switch-data records; btoi/htoi are real inline header definitions additionally called through Text function-pointer paths. Any coherent number-parsing owner split must preserve those bodies, claims, associations and caller contracts. A move is not authorized by this discovery alone; compiler flags/noinline/pragmas and blind buffer hoisting are not substitutes for ownership evidence. Missing memcpy calls remain a separate obligation.
payload.hypothesis: The current catch-all General translation unit inlines findnum into all five parser sites; original out-of-line scan calls suggest different visibility or compiler context.
